name: 画像検索の入力と絞り込みバー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0062 画像検索の入力と絞り込みバー. Input1 ORIGINAL crop controls exact back-chevron, microphone and filter geometry/optical weight. Input2 Japanese mock supplies exact query and layout; its two plain filter bars omit the circular knobs and source state dot. Input3 approved style only.
A compact horizontal bar on pure white #FFFFFF: left thin slate back CHEVRON, middle white rounded rectangular outlined search input, right source TWO horizontal filter lines with outlined circular knobs (top RIGHT, bottom LEFT). Preserve original line/circle proportions. A small forest-green #1F6444 dot sits at filter upper-right, adapting the source visible red state indicator to the brand; no invented count or runtime meaning. Utility glyphs #526173.
Search text verbatim "くつろげる部屋のアイデア", Meiryo Regular400 14/24, tracking0, ink#1D1D1D; fully readable on one line. At input right, original outline microphone: upright rounded capsule, U-shaped pickup, vertical stem and short horizontal foot. No search magnifier, clear X or extra controls. Native back-chevron is correct; do not turn it into shaft arrow. Source controls disputed small glyph anatomy.
White field, fine neutral border, restrained shadow, compact aligned heights/gaps. Only existing filter-state dot gets green; no mint or colored control fills. No enclosing card, photos, filter chips, device or English. High-resolution frontal wide component, modest white margins. Static raster candidate; input/filter/microphone/back behavior unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
